Vector files will produce the highest quality results. For non-vector files, upload an image with at least 150 dots per inch.

As a rule of thumb, the higher quality the image you upload, the higher quality your results will be. The image below shows the difference between a low quality image (left) and a high quality image (right).

Centering Your Design

If you are uncertain as to whether you've perfectly centered your design, don't worry. Simply attach a note to your order in the "notes" section of our design app to confirm that you would like to center your design.



[back to top]
Contrast Issues

After you submit your order, we'll review it to make sure that your design will be visible when printed on your garment. If we believe your design won't be visible when printed, we'll give you a call to let you know there's a problem.

Computer monitors tend to exaggerate the contrast between colors, making certain colors seem like they contrast well even when they do not. We advise against having a design that is the same color as the garment.

Example: In the image below, the order is printed without extra screens. Because the design is printed the same size, it looks smaller on the adult shirt and larger on the youth shirt.


Ordering Extra Screens
To order extra screens, go to the "Additional Instructions" step of the checkout process and click the checkbox that says "Order extra screens." Extra screens cost $26 per ink color.

[back to top]
Shipping to Multiple Addresses

At this time, we do not offer split shipping. [back to top]
Team Names and Numbers

You can order different names and/or numbers to be printed on each one of your garments.
Names cost $6.50 each. Numbers cost $3.90 each.
If you order custom names/numbers, you will need to order it for every garment in your order.
You can order custom names/numbers by clicking the "PERSONALIZE" button in the header bar of the page.

Note: The personalization portion of your design may have a different material and color than the rest of your design.
Building a Spreadsheet
To send your names/numbers data:
Click the "PERSONALIZE" button in the header bar of the page.
At the bottom of the screen that appears, click the "Name / Number Data" button.
Input the Name, Number, and Product data for each garment in your order.
Make sure the spreadsheet includes one row for every garment in your order, even if you would not like a name/number printed on the garment.

[back to top]
Why are your prices so low?

ooShirts was founded in 2007 with an investment of just $2000. From our founding, we had to be careful with our spending -- every dollar meant a lot to us.

In our effort to be frugal, we learned that the reason t-shirts cost so much isn't because it's expensive to print a t-shirt -- it's because most printing businesses have huge profit margins. And since nearly all printing companies charge high markups, people have become accustomed to paying more.

Our mission is to change this. Despite the opportunity to make more money, we would rather charge fair prices to more customers than charge inflated prices to fewer customers. Now, even as our shirts have reached the hands of millions, we will continue to hold the same principles that have brought us this far.

To learn more, visit our story.


[back to top]
How Your Price is Determined

The price of your order is determined based on three factors:
Style and color of garment
Number of colors in the design
Quantity and sizes
Reducing Costs
Doing any of the following will reduce your cost per shirt:
Reduce the number of colors or print locations in your design
Choose a less expensive garment
Order a white or natural colored garment
Order more garments to reduce the per unit price
Sample Pricing
The table below shows per-shirt pricing for a white Gildan Cotton T-Shirt with one front print location. All prices include free shipping and free setup.

Prices shown for white Gildan Cotton T-Shirt with 1 front print. Free shipping and setup included. All prices include our price match guarantee — if you find a lower price, we'll match it. Prices as of March 2026.

[back to top]
How do I place an order?

To place an order, follow the steps below!


Go to our design application to design your t-shirt.
After finishing your design, click the blue "Checkout" button at the top right.
Proceed through the checkout process and pay using a credit card.

Note: We begin the t-shirt printing process very quickly after orders are placed. Please make sure your order is finalized and 100% correct before placing the order.

[back to top]
What types of payment do you accept?

We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover credit card. At this time, we do not accept checks or purchase orders.

[back to top]
How do I submit a tax exempt order?

To submit a tax exempt order, please indicate your tax exemption status in the order instructions during the checkout process. You can also contact customer support after your order is placed for a tax refund.

[back to top]
Counting Print Colors

The number of colors in your design affects the price of your order. You can determine your color count by counting the number of colors in all text and images in your design, not including the color of the garment itself.

Shipping Options

We offer 3 shipping options:
Option	Guaranteed Delivery Date	Price
Standard	10 business days	Free!
Rush	5 business days	+25%
Super-rush	3 business days	+50%
Delivery dates are guaranteed, meaning that if an order arrives past your delivery date, you can return it for a full refund.

Note: The above chart applies to orders to the continental United States. Orders shipping outside the continental 48 states are charged an additional $1.24 per shirt (before rush fees) and do not have guaranteed delivery dates. They may take an additional 1 - 2 weeks to arrive.

[back to top]


Misprints and Late Deliveries

If your order turned out to be materially flawed, or if arrived later than our guaranteed delivery date, you can receive a resolution by filing a claim.


To report a late or flawed product, please file a claim.

Claims must be filed within 14 days after receipt of your goods.

[back to top]
Can I cancel my order after placing it?

In order to meet our guaranteed delivery dates, we process orders very quickly after they are placed (often within minutes).
If you reach us over the phone before we begin processing your order, we can cancel the order for you.
Once we start processing your order, we are unable to change or cancel your order.

Why Direct-to-Garment Printing Works for You
No Order Minimums

DTG printing has no minimum order quantity. Order one shirt or one hundred - there is no minimum purchase required and no penalty for small orders.

Unlimited Colors and Detail

Unlike screen printing, DTG can print unlimited colors in a single pass. Photographic images, gradients, fine details, and complex artwork all reproduce beautifully.

Fast Samples and Prototypes

Need a sample before committing to a large order? DTG makes it easy and affordable to print one or two shirts to test your design, colors, and fit.

Soft, Durable Prints

DTG prints are absorbed directly into the fabric, producing a soft hand feel that is virtually invisible to the touch. The result is a comfortable print that lasts through many washes.

Get Started

When to Choose DTG Over Screen Printing
Best for Small Runs

If you need fewer than 12 shirts, DTG is your best option. There is no setup involved, so the per-piece price is the same whether you order 1 shirt or 11.

Perfect for Complex Designs

Designs with many colors, gradients, photographic elements, or fine details are ideal for DTG. Screen printing is limited to a few solid ink colors per design.

Ideal for Testing and Sampling

Print a single sample to check your design before placing a larger order. DTG makes it affordable to test colors, placement, and sizing without committing to bulk.

When to Use Screen Printing

Frequently Asked Questions About DTG Print
What Is DTG Print?

DTG stands for direct-to-garment. It is a printing method that sprays ink directly onto the fabric using specialized inkjet printers. This allows for full-color, high-detail prints with a soft feel and no minimum order.

What is the Minimum Order for DTG Printing?

There is no minimum order for DTG printing. You can order as few as one shirt. This makes DTG ideal for samples, small runs, and individual custom pieces.

How Many Colors Can DTG Print?

DTG can print unlimited colors in a single pass, including photographic images, gradients, and fine details. There is no extra charge for additional colors.

How Long Does DTG Printing Take?

Standard DTG orders are produced and shipped within 7 business days with free shipping. Rush delivery (5 days, +25%) and super-rush delivery (3 days, +50%) are available.

Does DTG Print Fade or Crack?

No. DTG prints use high-quality water-based inks that are absorbed into the fabric. When properly cared for, DTG prints remain vibrant and crack-free through many wash cycles.

What Shirt Styles Work With DTG?

DTG works best on 100% cotton and cotton-dominant blends. We offer a wide range of compatible styles including t-shirts, hoodies, sweatshirts, and tank tops from top brands.

Can I Print a Sample Before Ordering in Bulk?

Yes. With no minimum order, you can print a single sample to check the quality, colors, and fit before placing a larger order.

How Much Does DTG Printing Cost?

DTG pricing depends on the shirt style and quantity. Every order includes free setup, free shipping, and free design review. Use our instant pricing tool for an exact quote. Prices are 30-50% below competitors.

Artwork Requirements
Accepted File Formats
Raster Files: PNG, JPG/JPEG, GIF, BMP
Vector Files: EPS, PS, AI
Photoshop Files: PSD, TIF/TIFF

If you are having problems uploading a file, or if you need assistance converting a file to another format, send your artwork file to help@ooshirts.com.

Image Quality
Vector files will produce the highest quality results. For non-vector files, upload an image with at least 150 dots per inch.

As a rule of thumb, the higher quality the image you upload, the higher quality your results will be. The image below shows the difference between a low quality image (left) and a high quality image (right).

[back to top]
Centering Your Design

If you are uncertain as to whether you've perfectly centered your design, don't worry. Simply attach a note to your order in the "notes" section of our design app to confirm that you would like to center your design.



[back to top]
Contrast Issues

After you submit your order, we'll review it to make sure that your design will be visible when printed on your garment. If we believe your design won't be visible when printed, we'll give you a call to let you know there's a problem.

Computer monitors tend to exaggerate the contrast between colors, making certain colors seem like they contrast well even when they do not. We advise against having a design that is the same color as the garment.


Examples of poor color contrast



Examples of good color contrast


[back to top]
Removing Background Colors

When you place your order, our production artists check to make sure your design does not have any excess background color.

In most cases, our artists can easily determine whether you intended to have the background color removed. (In the example below, we can easily assume the background color should be removed.) If we are unsure, one of our customer service representatives will give you a call to clarify the issue.



[back to top]
Match Colors in Your Design

Our artists can help you match the colors of different elements in your design. In the image below, the design on the left contains text that is slightly different from the color of the image. We alter the design such that the colors match perfectly,

Example: In the image below, the order is printed without extra screens. Because the design is printed the same size, it looks smaller on the adult shirt and larger on the youth shirt.


Ordering Extra Screens
To order extra screens, go to the "Additional Instructions" step of the checkout process and click the checkbox that says "Order extra screens." Extra screens cost $26 per ink color.

[back to top]
Shipping to Multiple Addresses

At this time, we do not offer split shipping. [back to top]
Team Names and Numbers

You can order different names and/or numbers to be printed on each one of your garments.
Names cost $6.50 each. Numbers cost $3.90 each.
If you order custom names/numbers, you will need to order it for every garment in your order.
You can order custom names/numbers by clicking the "PERSONALIZE" button in the header bar of the page.

Note: The personalization portion of your design may have a different material and color than the rest of your design.
Building a Spreadsheet
To send your names/numbers data:
Click the "PERSONALIZE" button in the header bar of the page.
At the bottom of the screen that appears, click the "Name / Number Data" button.
Input the Name, Number, and Product data for each garment in your order.
Make sure the spreadsheet includes one row for every garment in your order, even if you would not like a name/number printed on the garment.

[back to top]
Why are your prices so low?

ooShirts was founded in 2007 with an investment of just $2000. From our founding, we had to be careful with our spending -- every dollar meant a lot to us.

In our effort to be frugal, we learned that the reason t-shirts cost so much isn't because it's expensive to print a t-shirt -- it's because most printing businesses have huge profit margins. And since nearly all printing companies charge high markups, people have become accustomed to paying more.

Our mission is to change this. Despite the opportunity to make more money, we would rather charge fair prices to more customers than charge inflated prices to fewer customers. Now, even as our shirts have reached the hands of millions, we will continue to hold the same principles that have brought us this far.

To learn more, visit our story.


[back to top]
How Your Price is Determined

The price of your order is determined based on three factors:
Style and color of garment
Number of colors in the design
Quantity and sizes
Reducing Costs
Doing any of the following will reduce your cost per shirt:
Reduce the number of colors or print locations in your design
Choose a less expensive garment
Order a white or natural colored garment
Order more garments to reduce the per unit price
Sample Pricing

Prices shown for white Gildan Cotton T-Shirt with 1 front print. Free shipping and setup included. All prices include our price match guarantee — if you find a lower price, we'll match it. Prices as of March 2026.

[back to top]
How do I place an order?

To place an order, follow the steps below!


Go to our design application to design your t-shirt.
After finishing your design, click the blue "Checkout" button at the top right.
Proceed through the checkout process and pay using a credit card.

Note: We begin the t-shirt printing process very quickly after orders are placed. Please make sure your order is finalized and 100% correct before placing the order.

[back to top]
What types of payment do you accept?

We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover credit card. At this time, we do not accept checks or purchase orders.

[back to top]
How do I submit a tax exempt order?

To submit a tax exempt order, please indicate your tax exemption status in the order instructions during the checkout process. You can also contact customer support after your order is placed for a tax refund.

[back to top]

The number of colors in your design affects the price of your order. You can determine your color count by counting the number of colors in all text and images in your design, not including the color of the garment itself.

Why Direct-to-Garment Printing Works for You
No Order Minimums

DTG printing has no minimum order quantity. Order one shirt or one hundred - there is no minimum purchase required and no penalty for small orders.

Unlimited Colors and Detail

Unlike screen printing, DTG can print unlimited colors in a single pass. Photographic images, gradients, fine details, and complex artwork all reproduce beautifully.

Fast Samples and Prototypes

Need a sample before committing to a large order? DTG makes it easy and affordable to print one or two shirts to test your design, colors, and fit.

Soft, Durable Prints

DTG prints are absorbed directly into the fabric, producing a soft hand feel that is virtually invisible to the touch. The result is a comfortable print that lasts through many washes.

Get Started

When to Choose DTG Over Screen Printing
Best for Small Runs

If you need fewer than 12 shirts, DTG is your best option. There is no setup involved, so the per-piece price is the same whether you order 1 shirt or 11.

Perfect for Complex Designs

Designs with many colors, gradients, photographic elements, or fine details are ideal for DTG. Screen printing is limited to a few solid ink colors per design.

Ideal for Testing and Sampling

Print a single sample to check your design before placing a larger order. DTG makes it affordable to test colors, placement, and sizing without committing to bulk.

When to Use Screen Printing

For orders of 12 or more with 1-3 solid ink colors, screen printing is typically more cost-effective per piece. Our team can help you decide which method is right for your project.

Contact Sales

All-Inclusive Pricing With No Hidden Fees
What Your Price Includes

Every DTG order includes the shirt, full-color printing, free setup, free shipping, and a free expert design review. There are no additional charges.

30-50% Below Competitors

Our efficient production and direct manufacturer partnerships allow us to offer DTG pricing that is 30-50% below what other custom printers charge.

Bulk Discounts at Any Quantity

Even with DTG, the more you order, the less you pay per piece. Volume discounts apply automatically as your order quantity increases.

No Setup Fees or Color Charges

Unlike screen printing, DTG has no setup fees and no additional charges for extra colors. A full-color photographic print costs the same as a single-color design.

Get Instant Pricing

Print Quality That Lasts Wash After Wash
High-Quality Inks and Equipment

We use professional-grade DTG printers and premium water-based inks to produce vibrant, durable prints that stand up to repeated washing.

Expert Design Review

Our design team reviews every order for free before production. We check your artwork for resolution, color accuracy, and placement to ensure the best possible result.

Reprint Guarantee

If your DTG prints arrive with any defects, we will reprint your order at no cost. We guarantee the quality of every shirt we produce.

4.8 Out of 5 Stars

Our customers rate us 4.8 out of 5 stars based on 12,370 verified reviews. Our commitment to quality is why over 1 million customers have trusted us since 2007.

Get Started

7-Day Guaranteed Delivery
Production in 7 Business Days

Standard DTG orders are produced and shipped within 7 business days. Rush (5 days, +25%) and super-rush (3 days, +50%) options are available for urgent orders.

Real-Time Order Tracking

Track your order from approval through production and shipping. You will always know exactly where your order stands and when it will arrive.

Trusted by Schools and Businesses

Schools, businesses, and organizations trust us to deliver on time, every time. Our 7-day delivery guarantee means you can plan with confidence.

East and West Coast Production

We operate production facilities on both coasts so your order ships from the location closest to you, reducing transit times and ensuring fast delivery.

Get Started Now

Who Relies on Direct-to-Garment Printing
Artists and Designers

DTG is the preferred method for artists and designers who need full-color, high-detail reproduction of their artwork on apparel with no minimums.

Small Brands and Startups

Startups and small brands use DTG to launch merchandise without the risk of holding inventory. Print on demand, test designs, and scale as you grow.

Schools and Nonprofits

Schools and nonprofits appreciate the flexibility of DTG for small runs of spirit wear, event shirts, and fundraiser apparel without large minimum orders.

Event Planners and Organizers

Event planners use DTG for custom event merchandise, VIP shirts, and promotional apparel when they need full-color prints in small or medium quantities.

Businesses Testing Merch

Businesses use DTG to test new merchandise designs before committing to large screen printing runs. Print a few samples, gather feedback, and then scale up.

Start Your Order

Real People Ready to Help
Live Chat, Phone, and Email

Our support team is available seven days a week via live chat, phone, and email. Reach a real person who can help with your DTG order.

Design Assistance

Not sure if your artwork is DTG-ready? Our designers will review your files for free and make recommendations to ensure the best print quality.

Friendly, Knowledgeable Team

Our team members are experienced in custom printing and can answer your questions about DTG, file preparation, fabric selection, and more.

Order Updates at Every Step

We keep you informed from design approval through production and delivery. You will never wonder about the status of your order.

Chat With Us Now

Frequently Asked Questions About DTG Print
What Is DTG Print?

DTG stands for direct-to-garment. It is a printing method that sprays ink directly onto the fabric using specialized inkjet printers. This allows for full-color, high-detail prints with a soft feel and no minimum order.

What is the Minimum Order for DTG Printing?

There is no minimum order for DTG printing. You can order as few as one shirt. This makes DTG ideal for samples, small runs, and individual custom pieces.

How Many Colors Can DTG Print?

DTG can print unlimited colors in a single pass, including photographic images, gradients, and fine details. There is no extra charge for additional colors.

How Long Does DTG Printing Take?

Standard DTG orders are produced and shipped within 7 business days with free shipping. Rush delivery (5 days, +25%) and super-rush delivery (3 days, +50%) are available.

Does DTG Print Fade or Crack?

No. DTG prints use high-quality water-based inks that are absorbed into the fabric. When properly cared for, DTG prints remain vibrant and crack-free through many wash cycles.

What Shirt Styles Work With DTG?

DTG works best on 100% cotton and cotton-dominant blends. We offer a wide range of compatible styles including t-shirts, hoodies, sweatshirts, and tank tops from top brands.

Can I Print a Sample Before Ordering in Bulk?

Yes. With no minimum order, you can print a single sample to check the quality, colors, and fit before placing a larger order.

How Much Does DTG Printing Cost?

DTG pricing depends on the shirt style and quantity. Every order includes free setup, free shipping, and free design review. Use our instant pricing tool for an exact quote. Prices are 30-50% below competitors.
